attributes.content:
**EL-BEAM-1.3 Front beam lamps follow the requests**

FLCM_Lighting shall light the daylight running, low-beam and high-beam lamps of each side from the corresponding requests in DaylightRunningLightControl, LowBeamLightControl and HighBeamLightControl.

It shall dim the daylight running lamps of a side to position-lamp level while that side's low beam is lit.

description: Allocated to building block FrontLighting. Follow obligation for the front beam lamps. The dimming sits in the lamp module because it is a property of the lamp, which the BCM does not know.
